title: Interfaces for integral reconstruction and normalized exceptional realization
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme T. Define normalized strict coefficient systems by normalized transition adjuncts and common finite constructible cohomological and Tor intervals [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]. Define Reconstruction to record an equivalence from the full integral finite-Tor category to this normalized full subcategory, comparison isomorphisms with the actual reduction and total-limit functors, and their ambient unit/counit equations, together with the actual resolution and shift data. For a compactification c of f:X→Y, define Systems to record the ordinary exceptional adjoint, actual site comparisons and proper/open transport; SystemAdjunction records preservation of the normalized predicates, the restricted adjunction, origins and its specified transpose equation. Define the integral left/right operations by conjugation with reconstruction, and their adjunction by composition. Their finite evaluations are the actual reconstruction counits followed by system evaluations. Define Realization by its normalized proper/open system comparison, uniform bounds, exactness and coherent shifts, the lift of the prescribed compact-support functor, the primitive ambient realization equation and the equation I(u)=r followed by the inverse prescribed realization. These are the verbatim data previously in the integral reconstruction module; no definition or property changes. The withTransport construction copies the normalized adjunction fields while replacing only transport shift data on the same system functors. Coefficient and scheme conventions, the completed finite-Tor category, strict system operations, actual comparison and resolution data, and all shift conventions are precisely those of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-sf-integral-system-operations], [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], [def-pur-adic-exceptional-system-realization], [def-coef-reduction-limit-shift-data], [def-pur-sequence-adjoint-resolution-data], [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data], [def-sf-strict-etale-exceptional-adjoint-interfaces], [def-sf-exceptional-system-interfaces], [def-sf-sequence-adjoint-shift-interfaces], [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces], [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], [def-pur-adic-proetale-realization], [def-pur-adic-derived-site-realization], [def-pur-adic-support-realization], [def-sf-intrinsic-compact-support-realization], [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction], [lem-pur-integral-ctf-shift-closure].
